business_quality.description: Backtest-safe structured proxy derived only from pre-listing/RHP-sourced facts. No post-listing information is used.
business_quality.formula: 0.35_company_age_plus_0.35_revenue_scale_plus_0.30_profitability_continuity; normalize over available factors; minimum 2 factors
business_quality.note: This is an auditable V1.0 proxy for R1. Qualitative competitive-position enhancements may be proposed later by the learning loop but cannot silently change V1.0.

valuation.description: Absolute PE is a fallback only. Peer-relative valuation evidence, when verified, should override via explicit normalized_score.

sector_ipo_environment.description: Uses only NIFTY sessions dated on or before the IPO T2 cutoff. No listing outcome is used.

gmp_confirmation.description: Secondary confirmation only; capped by its frozen 5-point top-level weight. Historical runs use only explicitly dated GMP observations at or before T2.
